name: Deewin Tianxia Co., Ltd
summary: Deewin Tianxia Co., Ltd was founded in Xi'an in 2005 and belongs to Shaanxi Automobile Group Co Ltd. It offers logistics and supply chain services, finance and Internet of Vehicles data services in China. It provides warehousing for suppliers and truck makers, sells Shaanxi Heavy Duty and Shaanxi Commercial vehicles plus tires and lubricants, finances vehicle purchases and factoring, and sells IoV devices and analytics.
